title: Frontend: Draw Circles
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Draw Circles. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Inputs X and Y names x/y accept finite coordinates 0..200. Add circle creates an SVG circle with cx/cy and radius 10; invalid/blank coordinates show Invalid position. Undo removes latest; Clear removes all. This tests drawing-state geometry with typed coordinates, not pointer-coordinate conversion.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Convert client coordinates to local surface coordinates using its bounding rectangle, and account for scaling if logical and CSS sizes differ.
alternativeApproaches: Add redo and a keyboard placement mode without coupling geometry to browser viewport coordinates.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Scrolled page; scaled surface; boundary click.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
